integrity: The table gives a uniform proof for all parameters; exact 36-pair characteristic-polynomial and five cofactor calculations provide finite verification only. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only \(F_2(K_{m,n})\) for integers \(m,n\ge2\) with combinatorial unnormalized Laplacian. Integrality and spectral-radius information were known; new claim is the complete multiplicity spectrum and tree product. Barik--Verma (2024) full text was inaccessible, leaving an originality risk.
title: The complete Laplacian spectrum of two-token complete bipartite graphs
